title: Windmill
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sky glow behind windmill -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='26' fill='#2a3a5c'/>
  <!-- ground -->
  <rect x='0' y='78' width='100' height='22' fill='#3d8c40'/>
  <rect x='0' y='78' width='100' height='4' fill='#5cc45f'/>
  <!-- windmill tower -->
  <polygon points='40,80 60,80 55,42 45,42' fill='#e8dcc0'/>
  <polygon points='45,42 55,42 55,80 50,80' fill='#c9b98f'/>
  <!-- door -->
  <rect x='46' y='64' width='8' height='16' rx='2' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='72' r='1' fill='#f2c14e'/>
  <!-- window -->
  <rect x='47' y='50' width='6' height='6' rx='1' fill='#6ec6ff'/>
  <!-- roof cap -->
  <polygon points='45,42 55,42 50,34' fill='#b5452f'/>
  <!-- axle -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='4' fill='#f2c14e'/>
  <!-- blades -->
  <g>
    <!-- vertical blade -->
    <rect x='46' y='14' width='8' height='22' rx='2' fill='#f7f3e8'/>
    <rect x='46' y='14' width='3' height='22' fill='#d6cdb8'/>
    <!-- right blade -->
    <rect x='62' y='36' width='22' height='8' rx='2' fill='#f7f3e8'/>
    <rect x='62' y='40' width='22' height='4' fill='#d6cdb8'/>
    <!-- bottom blade -->
    <rect x='46' y='44' width='8' height='22' rx='2' fill='#f7f3e8'/>
    <rect x='46' y='44' width='3' height='22' fill='#d6cdb8'/>
    <!-- left blade -->
    <rect x='16' y='36' width='22' height='8' rx='2' fill='#f7f3e8'/>
    <rect x='16' y='40' width='22' height='4' fill='#d6cdb8'/>
  </g>
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='5' fill='#f2c14e'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='2' fill='#b5452f'/>
</svg>
